items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: But this guy, Arnett, myself, and Jelly Roll had two or three fellas there

ctx.x: Well, I was going to ask about those records you made for Jelly Roll Morton, and we played the Tiger Rag and Weary Blues. Can you tell anything about that session, who all was on that?

That's what I want to say. I know some of those fellas, but some of those guys got away from me. There were some of them that left Chicago. I don't know where they went to, but I know they left here, but I do know that Arnett Nelson was with us, because many times Arnett Nelson used to tease Jelly Roll, you know. Jelly Roll had a place down in the loop, you know. And he used to be down there, he wore derby, you know, in long shoes. Them guys draw the picture of Jelly Roll and made him mad. You know Jelly Roll,…
He played. Remember anything about that, whether those records were made, they were right here in Chicago, wasn't it? Yeah, all the records were made, they were right here in Chicago.
